Measures
This data set includes three subscales relating to attachment and social anxiety. Social Anxiety refers to the degree to which social anxiety plays a role in an individual’s daily life (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.9). Attachment-Related Anxiety refers to the presence of anxiety and avoidance in adult relationships (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.94). Self-Esteem refers to a person’s opinion of their own worth and abilities (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.85).


Data Analysis Strategy
In the Social Anxiety subscale, the data for variables SA_5, SA_9, and SA_11 were reverse keyed. In the Self-Esteem subscale, the data for variables SEst_2, SEst_5, SEst_6, SEst_8, and SEst_9 were reverse keyed.
